gaps.reason: The official page renders the whole chart as a bitmap image on static.clubs.nfl.com, so it contains no rows to parse. The brief forbids transcribing a chart by eye; no rows are produced and no players are named for this club. An authorised structured source is required.

sidecar.capture_method: fetch_page render of the official page (rendered text, not raw HTML)
sidecar.capture_limits: The fetch tool returns rendered text, so the page HTML and any client-side data are not retained. Row order and cell contents are as printed. The page date can only be recorded where the club prints one.
sidecar.http_note: page served with HTTP 200 in the fetch tool; status not otherwise probed
